name: jira
description: Jira Cloud: search and read issues with JQL, create issues, comment and change status. Needs the site address, the account e-mail and an API token.

tools.name: jira_check_connection
tools.description: Check the Jira connection (site, e-mail, API token) and show who the token belongs to.

tools.name: jira_list_projects
tools.description: List the Jira projects (key, name) the account can see.

tools.name: jira_search_issues
tools.description: Search issues with JQL, for example: project = ABC AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC. Returns key, summary, status, type, priority, assignee.

tools.name: jira_get_issue
tools.description: Read one issue: description, labels and the last comments.

tools.name: jira_create_issue
tools.description: Create an issue (this changes Jira). Ask the person before using it.

tools.name: jira_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an issue (this changes Jira). Ask the person before using it.

tools.name: jira_set_status
tools.description: Move an issue to another status, for example "In Progress" or "Done" (this changes Jira). Ask the person before using it.

jira_email.title: Account e-mail
jira_email.description: The e-mail of the Atlassian account that owns the token.

jira_api_token.title: API token
jira_api_token.description: id.atlassian.com, Security, Create and manage API tokens, Create API token. Stored as a secret. The token acts with your rights in Jira.
